meta.summary: AI spend envelopes set at 2.0x sector median for a scaling software company with loose controls and team-level variance bands of 60%.

shadow_ai.reimbursement_rule: AI tool purchases on personal or employee cards are reimbursable up to $50/month per employee only when no approved equivalent exists in the allowlist and the employee submits a use-case note within 30 days of purchase.

response_ladder.trigger: Team envelope burn reaches 90% before month end
Team envelope burn exceeds 100% or company envelope reaches 95%
Company envelope exceeds 110% or any agent kill threshold is breached

rationales.e1: Support usage on an allowlisted provider, inside its monthly envelope. Approved.
rationales.e2: Data team nightly embeddings at $38/day maps to roughly $1,140/month, comfortably inside the $8,000 Data envelope; routine pass with no action required.
rationales.e3: Search team cost per request rose 96% overnight with flat volume, breaching the 60% variance band on the Engineering envelope; likely cause is a model routing regression or prompt-length inflation introduced in the deploy, and the team lead should audit the diff.
rationales.e4: Subscription 3 for Marketing against a 5 subscription threshold. Approved.
rationales.e5: Fine-tune estimate 4800 against the 20000 approval line. Approved.
rationales.e6: 340 retries at 47 per hour, over the 50 retry limit. About 1090 in overnight burn prevented. Blocked, owner paged.
rationales.e7: The Growth team frontier-model exception for a demo build is self-serve eligible under the 168-hour window and the requested delta is within the $1,200 max_delta_usd cap; the exception is approved and will expire after 168 hours.
rationales.e8: A junior engineer personal API key at 22x baseline with no project tag triggers step 2 throttle under the response ladder; the Engineering lead must attribute the spend to a valid project tag within 12 hours or the key is blocked, preserving the experimentation carve-out for tagged work.
rationales.e9: The procurement agent purchased a $499 dataset license, which is within the $600 single_txn_ceiling_usd and falls under the data-licensing merchant scope on the agent card; the transaction is approved.
rationales.e10: The Design team AI video trial at $89/month duplicates a Sales tool with $1,400/year contract at 40% seat utilization; consolidating onto the existing contract recovers $840 in annualized unused seat value and the Design trial should be rerouted.
rationales.e11: Unrecognized provider charged 120; the new-provider rule is set to allow_with_review. Approved.
rationales.e12: Inference tagged internal-tool was submitted as COGS; the classification rule for project_tag internal-tool overrides to OpEx, and the submitting team should correct the tag in the expense system.
rationales.e13: Company spend at 87% of envelope against a 90% burn alert, 9 days left. Approved.
